issues.problem: No Middlesex location found. The company's own contact and locations pages list only a corporate office at 2 Ethel Road, Edison, plus a Bound Brook branch in search results, and the mapper's source URL was a Bound Brook category page. issues.problem: Network-affiliated brand practice (Advocare). The mapper excluded Evenly Orthodontics as a 'multi-site NJ brand' but kept this one, so the chain rule is applied inconsistently; Inspire PT (multi-office) and Monarch Training CrossFit (affiliate brand) are also borderline.
issues.fix: Apply one written rule for network/affiliate practices and re-tag these three entries.

issues.claim: Small single-directory entries with no address (e.g. S&J Engineering LLC, J J Marill Plumbing, Hriczo's Construction)
issues.problem: These cannot be verified as operating in the borough: S&J Engineering appears only in a state licensing PDF with a 'Middlesex 08846' postcode and no street address, and the plumbing/HVAC ones come from Birdeye records with no street number.
issues.fix: Keep them out of the outreach queue until a phone or address check succeeds, or mark clearly as 'unverified, no address'.

notes_on_method: Checked 46 claims against 30+ separate sources, opening every cited page where it was reachable; entries that only exist as a single Birdeye/Loc8NearMe record were treated as unverified rather than contradicted.

Excluded from the missing list: Rubicon Roofing Systems (207 Lincoln Blvd) surfaced by roof.info, because rubiconexteriors.com is a Lincoln, Nebraska contractor, so the roof.info Middlesex record looks like bad data; Advanced Dentistry - A Dental365 Company (7 Greenbrook Rd), a national-brand chain; Allison Roy - State Farm, a branded carrier agent; Rizick & Rizick CPA (Old Bridge) and Andrew S. Turkish (Florham Park) are outside the borough.
No entry in the list is food, delivery-only, government, school, hospital, worship or a bank branch; the only chain-related ambiguity is Advocare Mehta Pediatrics (noted above).
Coverage rate of eligible businesses already listed is 50/54 (about 93%), above the 70% bar; the FAIL rests on the three wrong-town entries plus the evidence and category defects.
data_gaps: amaltasdental.com and thedonsbsxsp.com fail direct fetch (JS-only) and were verified by driving a real browser instead; both matched the mapper's claims.
jbflooring.com returns an SSL protocol error, so the 549 Lincoln Blvd address for J Brothers Flooring comes from the search result summary rather than an opened page.

Cylex, YellowPages, SuperPages and some Birdeye pages returned 403 to direct fetches, so a few address/phone values rest on search summaries (Osborn & Son category, Kermizian Carpets, S&M Carpet, Rob Robinson Electric, Psak & Associates).
Roughly 90 list entries are supported only by one directory page with no independent confirmation; they were not individually disproven, only sampled.
No borough or county licensed-business roster was available to enumerate the borough exhaustively, so additional small home-based contractors may still be missing.
